versions.changelog:
Major update: Adds a full data analysis pipeline alongside the experiment pipeline. Sub-skills expand from 3 to 6 (7 total with orchestrator).

- Added data analysis workflow: psy-ana-designer (5-phase progressive design, 12-dimension method comparison, references 60 statistical methods and 48 chart types), psy-ana-coder (R and Python code generation, 12-step annotated script structure, 10-item quality gate), and psy-ana-reviewer (4 review modes, 5-dimension reproducibility audit, R 8 + Python 13 anti-pattern grep patterns).
- Renamed experiment sub-skills from psych-experiment-programming/coder/code-reviewer to psy-exp-designer/coder/reviewer, unifying the psy- prefix and -designer/-coder/-reviewer suffix convention across both chains.
- Dual-chain routing: orchestrator now distinguishes experiment requests from analysis requests by intent, routes to the correct chain, and supports cross-chain bridging (completed experiment → analysis entry). Ambiguous requests trigger clarification.
- Recovery Loop: both reviewers upgraded from single-pass audit to check → fix → re-audit cycle. Each issue maps to a repair path routing back to the appropriate coder. Cycle repeats until zero Critical + zero Major.
- Trigger keywords expanded to cover 5-language analysis and statistical workflows (中文/English/日本語/Deutsch/Français).
- All internal cross-references, READMEs, and orchestrator routing tree updated for the 7-skill dual-pipeline structure.

Version 1.2.0 — Major system orchestration and documentation update.

- Introduces a strict three-step chain: Programming → Coder → Reviewer—each is mandatory, ensuring quality and audit for psychological experiment code.
- Adds detailed system architecture diagrams, explicit user routing logic, and precise “Red Lines”/prohibitions to prevent common code and design errors.
- Extends paradigm coverage references (now 38) and clearly states platform compatibility (PsychoPy, jsPsych, Psychtoolbox).
- Clarifies that this skill acts only as a router/orchestrator—never generating code directly.
- Implements robust decision traceability, mandatory audits, and a four-layer code generation architecture for all supported platforms.
